about.heading: About Me
about.bio: I’m Mohsin Malik, a Content Strategy Specialist and Video Editor. I create intelligent, data-driven Solutions with a focus on elegant design and real-world impact.

timeline.event: Joined TachonTech as a software engineer

projects.title: Lenzeit
projects.description: AI-powered media delivery platform for photographers and studios. Built features including AI photo sorting, face-based photo discovery, privacy-controlled event galleries, and automated media delivery workflows.

projects.title: Citizen Rights Legal RAG
projects.description: Legal question-answering system built with a hybrid RAG architecture combining semantic vector search, BM25 keyword retrieval, and a knowledge graph to improve retrieval of legal provisions, sections, and relationships across Pakistani legal documents.

projects.title: ChatSetGo
projects.description: AI-powered business automation platform for WhatsApp and social messaging. Built conversational AI workflows, automated customer interactions, backend services, and workflow automation using LLMs, Django, React, and n8n.

projects.title: Kai-Cure
projects.description: AI-powered clinical assistant that uses voice recognition and LLMs to process doctor-patient conversations and generate structured SOAP notes, reducing manual documentation and helping clinicians organize consultation records.

projects.title: Grade Mate
projects.description: AI-assisted academic assessment platform that automates quiz and assignment evaluation while providing student performance analytics. Built with a web frontend and Django backend, with computer vision and NLP-based capabilities for automated assessment workflows.

projects.title: CropX
projects.description: Full-stack precision agriculture system integrating Arduino-based IoT sensors to collect real-time soil and environmental data. Built a Python machine learning pipeline to analyze NPK, moisture, and weather data and provide predictive crop insights and irrigation recommendations through a React interface.

projects.title: Fraud Detection System
projects.description: Machine learning fraud detection system using XGBoost to identify potentially fraudulent financial transactions. Includes a Flask-based administration dashboard for monitoring predictions, confidence scores, alerts, and model outputs.

projects.title: PULSE AI
projects.description: Big Data analytics and machine learning platform designed to process complex corporate datasets, uncover hidden patterns and anomalies, and generate predictive insights to support data-driven business decisions.

projects.title: Breast Cancer Detection
projects.description: Deep learning computer vision project for detecting and segmenting breast cancer-related abnormalities from medical imagery. Explored deep learning-based image analysis and segmentation workflows using Python and modern computer vision techniques.

projects.title: US Financial Waste Tracker
projects.description: Interactive analytics dashboard that combines publicly available US government data and APIs to explore, track, and analyze government financial spending and potential waste.

projects.title: Selenium Automation Bot
projects.description: Browser automation system designed for multi-user form submission workflows. Automated repetitive web interactions using Selenium and implemented mechanisms for handling CAPTCHA-based workflows.

projects.title: Lip Gloss Ecommerce
projects.description: Full-stack ecommerce platform developed with Laravel, implementing product management, customer-facing shopping workflows, and backend ecommerce functionality.

projects.title: React AI Chatbot
projects.description: Web-based conversational AI application built with React and OpenAI's API, providing users with real-time natural language conversations through a responsive chat interface.

experience.details: ChatSetGo is a WhatsApp business automation platform that streamlines customer communication and business workflows using AI and automation.

Delivered high-quality software solutions for a diverse range of international clients.

testimonials.author: Project Collaborator
testimonials.text: Mohsin has a strong ability to turn complex AI ideas into practical, working solutions. He was particularly good at breaking problems down and iterating quickly.

testimonials.author: Backend Project
testimonials.text: Working with Mohsin on the backend was a smooth experience. He understood the requirements quickly and focused on building solutions that were reliable and easy to extend.

testimonials.author: AI Project Collaborator
testimonials.text: Mohsin brings a practical approach to AI engineering. He doesn't just focus on getting a model working—he thinks about retrieval, performance, APIs, and how the whole system fits together.

testimonials.author: Team Collaborator
testimonials.text: Mohsin was proactive when solving technical problems and wasn't afraid to dig into issues until he found a workable solution. His problem-solving mindset stood out.

testimonials.author: Project Manager
testimonials.text: Mohsin consistently took ownership of his tasks and was able to work across both AI and backend development. He was dependable when dealing with challenging technical requirements.

testimonials.author: Engineering Colleague
testimonials.text: One of Mohsin's strengths is his ability to work across different parts of a product—from backend APIs and databases to AI pipelines and automation.

testimonials.author: Automation Project
testimonials.text: Mohsin understood the workflow we wanted to automate and translated it into a practical solution. The focus was always on reducing repetitive work and making the process easier to manage.

testimonials.author: AI Engineering Collaborator
testimonials.text: Mohsin has a strong interest in applied AI and is always experimenting with better ways to improve systems. His work with RAG, automation, and AI integrations shows a very hands-on engineering approach.

testimonials.author: Software Engineering Peer
testimonials.text: Mohsin is a curious and persistent engineer. When something doesn't work as expected, he investigates the problem, tests alternatives, and keeps improving the implementation.
